description_en: Updates the encryption configuration of a Logstore. You can create encryption configurations for the Logstore and enable or disable the encryption feature
description_zh: 更新日志库的加密配置。可以为日志库创建加密配置、开启或关闭日志加密功能
kebab_example: aliyun sls update-log-store-encryption --project test-project --logstore test-logstore --enable true --encrypt-type default --user-cmk-info regionId=cn-hangzhou roleArn=acs:ram::12344000:role/xxxxx keyId=f5136b95-2420-ab31-xxxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLogStoreEncryption

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to enable the encryption feature. After you update the encryption configuration of the Logstore, you can modify only the enable parameter in subsequent update requests. You cannot modify the encryptType or userCmkInfo parameters.
parameters.description_zh:
是否开启日志加密。
加密配置更新成功后，后续的加密配置更新请求只允许修改是否开启日志加密，不允许修改 encryptType、userCmkInfo 参数。
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the encryption feature. After you update the encryption configuration of the Logstore, you can modify only the enable parameter in subsequent update requests. You cannot modify the encryptType or userCmkInfo parameters
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启日志加密。
加密配置更新成功后，后续的加密配置更新请求只允许修改是否开启日志加密，不允许修改 encryptType、userCmkInfo 参数
parameters.name: enable

parameters.description_en: The encryption algorithm. Valid values: default, m4, sm4\_ecb, sm4\_cbc, sm4\_gcm, aes\_ecb, aes\_cbc, aes\_cfb, aes\_ofb, and aes\_gcm.
parameters.help_en: The encryption algorithm. Valid values: default, m4, sm4\_ecb, sm4\_cbc, sm4\_gcm, aes\_ecb, aes\_cbc, aes\_cfb, aes\_ofb, and aes\_gcm
parameters.name: encrypt_type

parameters.description_en: Optional. If you use a BYOK key to encrypt logs, you must specify this parameter. If you use the service key of Simple Log Service to encrypt logs, you do not need to specify this parameter.
parameters.description_zh: 可选，当通过用户自带密钥（BYOK）加密时，请填写此选项。当通过日志服务自带的服务密钥加密时，无需填写此选项。

fields.description_en: The ID of the CMK to which the BYOK key belongs. You can create a CMK in KMS. The CMK must be in the same region as the endpoint of Simple Log Service.
fields.description_zh: BYOK的主密钥ID，可通过阿里云密钥管理服务创建一个主密钥，主密钥地域需要与日志服务访问接入点相同。
fields.help_en: The ID of the CMK to which the BYOK key belongs. You can create a CMK in KMS. The CMK must be in the same region as the endpoint of Simple Log Service
fields.help_zh: BYOK的主密钥ID，可通过阿里云密钥管理服务创建一个主密钥，主密钥地域需要与日志服务访问接入点相同
fields.name: key_id

fields.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the Resource Access Management (RAM) role.The value is in the acs:ram::12344\*\*\*:role/xxxxx format. To use a BYOK key to encrypt logs, you must create a RAM role and grant the AliyunKMSReadOnlyAccess and AliyunKMSCryptoUserAccess permissions to the RAM role. You must grant the API caller the PassRole permission on the RAM role.
fields.description_zh: RAM角色的ARN，格式为 acs:ram::12344***:role/xxxxx。使用 BYOK 加密需要先创建一个 RAM角色，并授予给该角色AliyunKMSReadOnlyAccess、AliyunKMSCryptoUserAccess权限。同时授予此 API 访问者该RAM 角色的 PassRole 权限。
